title.zh: 在塔克洛班市Marasbaras区设立国立中学，名称为Marasbaras国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in the District of Marasbaras, Tacloban City, to Be Known as the Marasbaras National Hlgh School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in the District of Marasbaras, Tacloban City, to Be Known as the Marasbaras National Hlgh School, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Marasbaras National Hlgh tại Quận Marasbaras, Quận Tacloban City, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียน Marasbaras National Hlgh ในเขต Marasbaras เขต Tacloban City และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Marasbaras National Hlgh di Distrik Marasbaras, Distrik Tacloban City, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Marasbaras National Hlgh di Daerah Marasbaras, Daerah Tacloban City, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1992/ra_7389_1992.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established a national high school in the District of Marasbaras, Tacloban City, to be known as the Marasbaras National High School.
The Secretary of Education, Culture and Sports shall issue the rules and regulations necessary to implement this Act.
The amount necessary for the implementation of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
